notes: The 3D game's spells, in hotbar slot order. id is permanent (saved and sent); effect names the client's chemistry rule and is never saved. Player text lives in name, label, hotbar_label and cast_caption, which the science lint scans. See docs/loop/items/I-026/spec.md.

spells.name: Fire
spells.label: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O
spells.cast_caption: Fire spell: a gas flame. Methane burns: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O, and lots of heat.
spells.prompt_seedling: Fire: methane burns with oxygen. Change the numbers until the scale is level.
spells.prompt_apprentice: Fire: write the balanced equation for methane burning in oxygen.

spells.name: Water
spells.label: H₂O absorbs heat
spells.cast_caption: Water soaks up heat and cools things below their ignition temperature.
spells.prompt_sprout: Make water! Copy the balls in the picture.
spells.prompt_seedling: Water: build one water molecule from atom tiles.
spells.prompt_apprentice: Water: write the formula of liquid water, with its state symbol.

spells.name: Frost
spells.label: N₂(l) boils at −196 °C
spells.cast_caption: Liquid nitrogen boils at −196 °C (77 K), pulling heat out of anything it touches.
spells.prompt_sprout: Make liquid nitrogen! It is super cold. Copy the balls in the picture.
spells.prompt_seedling: Frost: build one nitrogen molecule. Liquid nitrogen is very, very cold.
spells.prompt_apprentice: Frost: write the formula of liquid nitrogen, with its state symbol.

spells.name: CO₂
spells.label: CO₂ blanket, no O₂
spells.cast_caption: CO₂ from an extinguisher is heavier than air: it smothers fire by pushing the oxygen away.
spells.prompt_sprout: Make carbon dioxide! Copy the balls in the picture.
spells.prompt_seedling: CO₂: build one carbon dioxide molecule.
spells.prompt_apprentice: CO₂: write the formula of carbon dioxide gas, with its state symbol.
